entries: Night after night, {first} turned {THING:portable} over and thought of {SOMEONE}.

For days, {first} {ACT_PERSON} {CLOSE} {MANNER}, and nothing was decided.

{first} wanted {PRIZE:!inner} and was torn by {FEELING}, and {place} offered no advice.
Every road out of {place} led toward {SOMEONE}, and {first} stayed where {first} was.
